title: Autotune have wrong Profile
symptom: When running Autotune, the profile it uses contains completely incorrect data. The user has only one profile, so they rule out selecting the wrong one. Screenshots show different basal rates in the profile plugin, autotune input, autotune calculated, and current running profile.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but a maintainer (Philoul) suspects an issue with the Autotune plugin using a hard-coded profile as input regardless of selection, and later states it is fixed with a commit.
fix: The issue was fixed with commit 2ae01d546f4194e707213f1d54a60de547e23648.
